about: The frame a window shows (clarity_spec::frame::shown, the designer's shownFrame in runtimes/web/src/screen/frame.ts): each region the window has replaces the app's of the same kind (a sidebar, of the same side); a region it lacks is the app's; a dialog shows none. `app` and `own` name the regions each has (menu, toolbar, left, right, footer); `shows` says, per region, whose it shows: own, app, or null for none.

cases.name: a window without regions shows the app's
a window's own region replaces the app's of its kind
a sidebar replaces only the one on its side
without an app frame a window shows its own
